required_review_scale: whole saved image plus direct crops only if needed; primary face at approximately 13 percent frame height and primary full body about 70 percent planned. No inferred off-frame endpoints.

gates.criterion: Primary visible facial proportions/features and chin-length dark bob/wispy fringe resemble the supplied reference within the specified appearance-only scope.
The image visibly reads as musicians sharing a working-stage cue and musical action, with guitar and at least two bandmates; decorative instruments alone fail.

One lead performer owns both hands, left fingertips contact fretboard strings and right pick contacts strings over pickups; full wrist chains, instrument neck/body and targets are distinguishable together.
Lead guitar output plug, continuous visible cable route, and amplifier input plug are all visible together and connected; partial route or implied endpoint fails.
Lead has both shoes on stage and a readable strap carrying the guitar; drummer seated support is coherent.
Lead head cue and drummer response/snare contact are connected by attention in one frame rather than isolated poses.

strict_success: All six gates must be visible and pass; partial/unobservable is fail for strict whole-scene success. Do not treat prompt-audit PASS as pixels.
reference_observation: Visible portrait only: softly tapered oval face, dark rounded almond eyes, gently arched brows, small softly rounded nose, natural pink lips, chin-length straight dark bob and fine wispy forehead strands. Identity, age and biography not inferred.
